sign:sun:Aries.title: Sun in Aries
sign:sun:Aries.summary: Your spark is bold and direct—you're happiest leading the way, starting fresh, and trusting your instinct to act.

sign:sun:Taurus.title: Sun in Taurus
sign:sun:Taurus.summary: You shine through steadiness and warmth, finding deep joy in comfort, beauty, and building something lasting at your own patient pace.

sign:sun:Gemini.title: Sun in Gemini

sign:sun:Cancer.title: Sun in Cancer
sign:sun:Cancer.summary: Your heart leads with care—you shine by nurturing others, trusting your feelings, and creating a home where people feel safe.

sign:sun:Leo.title: Sun in Leo
sign:sun:Leo.summary: You're meant to be seen—warm, generous, and creative, you light up rooms simply by sharing your big, genuine heart.

sign:sun:Virgo.title: Sun in Virgo
sign:sun:Virgo.summary: You shine through thoughtful care, noticing the details others miss and quietly making things better for the people you love.

sign:sun:Libra.title: Sun in Libra

sign:sun:Scorpio.title: Sun in Scorpio
sign:sun:Scorpio.summary: You feel everything deeply and aren't afraid of real intensity, finding your power in honesty, transformation, and loyal, meaningful bonds.

sign:sun:Sagittarius.title: Sun in Sagittarius

sign:sun:Capricorn.title: Sun in Capricorn

sign:sun:Aquarius.title: Sun in Aquarius

sign:sun:Pisces.title: Sun in Pisces
